events.note: Owner reported manually sharing ERN to approximately 50–60 Facebook groups. Use only as context for aggregate referral/traffic observation; do not infer reach, impressions, conversions or revenue.

audienceContext.inferenceBoundary: Audience identity is contextual only; ERN analytics does not identify individual visitors as nomads.

baseline.note: Same-day aggregate baseline captured after the owner reported the Facebook group posting wave. Use only for later deltas; it is not a pre-campaign control and cannot prove causation.
